title: Install an app the careful way
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- Nothing will glow yellow. You decide where to click.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

Read before you install. An app that wants more than its job needs is the one to walk away from.

playgroundTask.goal: You installed an app and cleaned up another
playgroundTask.hint: Search by what an app does, not by its name. An app's page shows its rating, its reviews, and the permissions it will ask for — all before you commit to installing.

steps.say: You want to send messages and make video calls. Find an app that does that.
Open its page and read what other people say about it.
Give it the access it genuinely needs to make video calls.
Go and look at everything installed on this computer.
MusicMaker is taking up space and you never use it. Get rid of it.

drDigitalSuccess: You searched by purpose, checked the reviews, granted only what the app needed, and cleared out something you were not using. That is how to keep a computer healthy.
drDigitalHint: Type what you want the app to do into the search box. The app's own page lists its reviews and its permissions. Your installed apps live under the second tab at the top.
